Question 20
?

Find the equation of the right-opening parabola that has its vertex at (1,−3) and passes through the point (3,0).

a
(y+3)2=92(x−1)
b
(y−1)2=98(x+3)
c
(x+3)2=−9(y−1)
d
(y−3)2=92(x+1)
e
(y+3)2=36(x−1)
